title: L114 — THE RANGE THAT WAS LOADING
voice: You stared at the same price range for three days, convinced that nothing was happening on the chart.
While you waited, orders were stacking on both sides of the range, because every buyer and every seller needed someone on the other end.
The range was not dead time, it was a spring being loaded by the weight of every position that entered during the pause.
When the spring released, the move did not come from new money, it came from every stop that was parked inside the range.
Consolidation is not waiting, it is loading. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.
